name: Dr. V. H. Stickney
mentions: Dr. Stickney of Dickinson, was here last Saturday. Hereafter, he will be in Medora twice a week. The Dr. is now the railroad surgeon, taking the place of Dr. Robarts, who now has cha…

…formerly injured. This time he was kicked by a calf in such a way as to tear off the right eye-lid. Dr. V. H. Stickney, who is attending him, states that only with the utmost care can the eye be saved. The sufferer is now resting as well as could be expected at the Northern Pacific hotel…
